user_questions.question: Which promotions should get the heads-up? Status__c values are Active/Expired/Canceled (unrestricted; Agent actions also write 'Draft'). Options: (a) Active only [recommended], (b) any status except Canceled/Expired, (c) all promotions with an end date.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Active only; scheduled path 7 days before End Date; email the Storefront's Primary Contact using an email template; one email per promo.

user_questions.question: Should contacts with Email Opt Out (Contact.HasOptedOutOfEmail) be skipped? Options: (a) skip opted-out contacts [recommended], (b) send anyway as an operational notice.
user_questions.simulated_answer: No preference; use your recommended default.

skill_friction: Step 5 says to predict the answer and skip questions with safe defaults; the opt-out question was predictably 'no preference' but Rule 4 (drop unstated scope filters) and compliance pull opposite ways, so it is unclear whether an opt-out filter is an intent question or an implementation default.
The R split rule ('a split sends both halves, which together count as one retry') does not say how to log the two halves in run.json kinds; logged both as 'retry'.

After three wrong AskCoworker claims (scheduled path cannot be offset before a date field, undelete fires flows, Agentforce_Reference_App grant), the skill requires verifying every kept fact, but platform-behavior claims cannot be queried; the skill could say explicitly that these fall back to 'assumption (documented platform behavior)'.
No guidance for the recurring 'already meets entry criteria' backfill problem with 'only when updated to meet condition' scheduled paths; the data-step rule covers it only generically.

Spec-format module rules cover reports/dashboards folders but not email template folders; chose unfiled$public since no email folders exist, but the rule about named folders for shared reports might be read as applying.
